description: We are a team of dedicated Sophomores from Lake Stevens High School. In our free time we enjoy coding, reading manga, hiking, and bouldering. We are happy to accept new teammates as long as you can bring a good attitude, and work ethic!
summary: We developed a website that uses NASA Power and GAEZ data to create crop recommendations and provide analysis to Indian farmers who yield low ROI annually. This matters because it’ll provide security for rural Indian farmers and allow them to plant more suitable crops for their land.
details: This program addresses the challenge farmers face when deciding what to plant and how to manage each plot. Soil, water access, weather, crop suitability, and market prices can all affect a crop’s costs and returns, but that information can be hard to bring together.
